correctness.rationale: The linear-extension/matching bijection gives the stated binomial polynomial. The derivative formula is exact. value.rationale: Ferroni–Morales–Panova explicitly identify complement zig-zag as an interesting width-two family but provide only finite evidence for its order-polynomial positivity. An all-dimensional analytic proof, generalized to all path-edge subsets, resolves this motivated example and identifies the transparent matching injection needed for a published hereditary lifting criterion. The conclusion is structurally motivated, not an arbitrary parameter cut or routine small case.
